name: Rippit
description: Find out what your customers are actually telling you. Rippit reads every support ticket, call, and chat transcript in full - not summaries - so you can surface the themes driving your volume, quantify what they’re costing you, and back every finding with the customer’s own words.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Rippit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Rippit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.rippit.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Rippit MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rippit lists 23 MCP tools, including add_formula_column, aggregate_table, create_worksheet, create_worksheet_template, describe_column, describe_table, describe_worksheet_template, enrich_worksheet, export_worksheet, find_quotes, get_enrich_status, and get_quotes_status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Rippit?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Rippit in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Rippit requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Rippit is developed by rippit. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
